generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The three changes consistently gate the pop-specific metrics logic behind `!brokerConfig.isPopConsumerKVServiceEnable()`, so that when the KV service is enabled, pop consumers fall through to the standard (non-pop) offset path. The pattern is coherent across `getConsumerLagStats`, `getInFlightMsgStats`, and `getAvailableMsgCount`.
